_comment: Rule catalogue (prompt §8). Rules are deterministic code in app/rules.py, parameterised from this file.
disconnect_window: The disconnect day is billable. Post-disconnect days run from disconnect date + 1 until the day before the next COMPLETED RECONNECT on the same premise, or open-ended if none.

R1.name: Billed after disconnect
R1.fires_when: A draft or issued bill covers post-disconnect days

R2.name: Estimated reads after disconnect
R2.fires_when: Post-disconnect days within an affected bill carry ESTIMATED reads

R3.name: Complaint without billing hold
R3.fires_when: A CRM case in a complaint category, opened on or after the disconnect date, with billing_hold_set = N

R4.name: Disputed revenue posted
R4.fires_when: An affected bill is DISPUTED or has an open BILLING_DISPUTE case, and its GL journal is posted. High if the period is CLOSED at scenario time, else Medium.

PB1.name: SA active despite stop
PB1.fires_when: The SA is ACTIVE at scenario time despite a STOP_SERVICE or MOVE_OUT disconnect

PB2.name: Integration message failed
PB2.fires_when: The disconnect's integration message is ERROR, SKIPPED or UNPROCESSED at scenario time

PB3.name: ID near-match
PB3.fires_when: An OMS premise has no crosswalk match, but a crosswalk premise is within Levenshtein distance 1 (O/0 and I/1 equal)

causes.label: Integration failure
causes.condition: Integration ERROR with an open To Do

causes.label: Bill ran before stop processed
causes.condition: Message UNPROCESSED at scenario time, or processed after the affected bill run

causes.label: Non-pay window estimated
causes.condition: NONPAY disconnect with estimated post-disconnect days

s_codes.S2: MDM read types and estimates tied to premise status
s_codes.S4: CRM complaint categories that trigger holds
